decisions.reason: The conjugating word fixes i; for i=1,j=3 its permutation is (2 3), not a cycle on 1,2,3. The incorrect incidental label description is repaired. Purity still follows from conjugating the identity permutation, and the word and inverse-slicing naming convention are unchanged.

The asserted planar inclusion on the dense interior cannot continuously identify distinct banks. Replaced this fatal spine gap by an explicit orientation-preserving shear, radial disk push-out, vertical retraction |y|>=d(x) to y=±d(x), removal of exterior rays, and collapse of the interval tree. Positive based meridians map to the wedge basis; the reduced-word tree covering proves higher homotopy vanishes. The Statement and no-choice claim are preserved.

The projected concatenation had its middle path in F_n while the outer paths lie in F_{n-1}. Inserted the missing projection, whose composite with the section is the identity; constant outer paths then give the original loop class. The explicit section, collision bounds, finite-set path-connectedness and conjugation splitting are valid and choice-free; the Statement is unchanged.

Q_n truncates to Q'_n, not to the independently defined canonical Q_{n-1}; at n=2 these one-point configurations are -1/12 and 0. The Statement now explicitly targets the component group fixing Q'_n. The proof constructs a boundary-fixed R carrying Q'_n to the canonical configuration, transports the rank-(n-1) isomorphism by conjugation and R_*, and proves naturality with the same lifted isotopy. The two inverse signs cancel in Push=Theta_n kappa; injectivity, kernel equality and surjectivity follow from the actual fibre exact sequence.

The affine map translates positions, not displacement vectors; its application to rho alone drops the translation and fails at time zero. Replaced this false identity by lambda rho^(n)=rho^(n-1), and g_1(m±rho)=g_1(m)±lambda rho. The midpoint, support bounds, injective comparison homotopy, moving-basepoint transport and kernel/quotient generation induction are then valid, including the empty older-generator family at n=2. The Statement is unchanged.

With nu(gamma_1^k)=k and kappa(gamma_1)=A_12^-1, kappa nu^-1 gives A_12^-k. Inserted the negation automorphism before nu^-1 to obtain k->A_12^k, and correctly assigned A_12->1 to the inverse map. Exactness with PB_1=1 gives kappa an isomorphism; the one-letter reduced-word model proves infinite cyclicity and the winding sign remains -1. Added the actual canonical-basepoint convention dependencies cited by the Example.

The quotient basepoint Q'=(-1/8,0) differs from canonical Q^(2)=(-1/12,1/12), so the former direct canonical identification was undefined. Defined the affine configuration path eta and its loop-conjugation transport tau, checked the full-twist homotopy with scale 4/3 and translated midpoint, and named a'=tau(A_12^(2)). Forgetting sends a to a', and the normalized far-right section sends a' to a. Also removed nonexistent b,c counterparts in PB_2 and corrected the concatenation schedule to first-quarter alpha, second-quarter lift, last-half reverse alpha. Centrality abc=(sigma_1 sigma_2)^3 gives the retained action x->(bc)^-1 x(bc).

downstream_reviews.snippet:
[F3] The standard generators are $A_{rs}=\Psi_n^{\mathrm{conf}}([W_{rs}])$, where
$$W_{rs}=\sigma_{s-1}\cdots\sigma_{r+1}\sigma_r^2\sigma_{r+1}^{-1}\cdots\sigma_{s-1}^{-1}.$$
The rightmost factor is the bottom one, $[\gamma\star\beta]=[\gamma][\beta]$, and $\Psi_n^{\mathrm{conf}}([\beta])=(\iota^F_*[z_\beta])^{-1}$ for the ordered coordinate loop $z_\beta$ ([[def-standard-pure-braid-generators]], [[cor-pure-geometric-braids-are-the-fundamental-group-of-ordered-configurations]]).

downstream_reviews.snippet: [F1] In $B_n$ the two Artin relations hold and adjacent inverse $\sigma$-pairs may be freely inserted and deleted. For $1\le i<j\le n$, set $\widetilde A_{ij}:=\sigma_{j-1}\cdots\sigma_{i+1}\sigma_i^{2}\sigma_{i+1}^{-1}\cdots\sigma_{j-1}^{-1}\in B_n$; its image under $\varphi$ is the geometric standard generator $A_{ij}$ of [[def-standard-pure-braid-generators]], since $\varphi(\sigma_r)=[\sigma_r]$ and $\varphi$ preserves the displayed stacking product ([[def-braid-group-by-the-artin-presentation]], [[prop-the-artin-presentation-surjects-onto-geometric-braids]], [[def-standard-pure-braid-generators]]). The words $\alpha_j$ satisfy $\alpha_j=\sigma_j\cdots\sigma_{n-1}$ and $\alpha_n=1$, and $x_i=\alpha_{i+1}^{-1}\sigma_i^{2}\alpha_{i+1}$ ([[def-zariski-braid-combing-words-alpha-and-x]]).

downstream_reviews.snippet: [F4] The standard generators are the classes $A_{ij}=\Psi([W_{ij}])$ of the words $W_{ij}=\sigma_{j-1}\cdots\sigma_{i+1}\sigma_i^2\sigma_{i+1}^{-1}\cdots\sigma_{j-1}^{-1}$ (first-under-second stacking, empty outer blocks for $j=i+1$), where $\Psi([\beta])=(\iota^F_*[z_\beta])^{-1}$ for the coordinate path $z_\beta$ of a pure geometric braid $\beta$; $\Psi$ is an isomorphism $G_m^{\mathrm{pure}}\to PB_m$, so $A_{ij}=\iota^F_*((a_{ij})^{-1})$ for the open-disc class $a_{ij}=[z_{W_{ij}}]$, and the word identity gives $[\gamma\star\beta]=[\gamma][\beta]$ ([[def-standard-pure-braid-generators]], [[cor-pure-geometric-braids-are-the-fundamental-group-of-ordered-configurations]], [[def-pure-braid-group-from-ordered-configurations]]).
